> NeuroX is a non-invasive Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) platform that translates human eye movements (EOG) and jaw muscle contractions (EMG) into real-time robotic controls. Powered by an ESP32-S3 and a custom digital signal processing pipeline, it completely replaces physical joysticks with biological intent. By electronically hijacking an RC transmitter with a transistor array, NeuroX serves as a low-latency, untethered proof-of-concept for hands-free assistive mobility and advanced human-computer interaction.
